executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $184.74 per resident day (47.8% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 4.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $996,220, 9.4% of the $10,632,921 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,877,733, $32.62 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $950,813 (50.6%), allocated fringe $379,063 (20.2%), non-wage costs $547,857 (29.2%). Raw food was $503,543 ($8.75 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $564.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $572,788, $9.95 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $385,479 (67.3%), allocated fringe $153,680 (26.8%), non-wage costs $33,629 (5.9%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $449,105, $7.8 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $302,171 (67.3%), allocated fringe $120,467 (26.8%), non-wage costs $26,467 (5.9%).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
